author: Top Gear
description:
This is the new Ferrari 296 Challenge Stradale, and it both ditches the 296 GTB’s hybrid system and adorns the body with 911 GT3 RS-aping amounts of aero. Power comes down to ‘only’ 670hp, but weight drops 140kg too. It’s a trick Ferrrari’s played before, when it junked the LaFerrari’s e-boost to make the non-hybrid V12 Daytona SP3 – but that was a 1-of-599, £2m ‘Icona’ model and the new hardcore 296 CS isn’t limited and is cheaper than a 296 Speciale. Unless you’re a 296 GTB owner and your residuals just took a further bath, what’s not to like?
